content_blocks.label: clause_1._Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I direct that all my personal property, including but not limited to jewelry, artwork, and collectibles, be distributed equally among my children, Sarah and Michael.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Real_Property
content_blocks.text: My residence located at 456 Elm Street, Maplewood, State of Verano, shall be left to my son, Michael, free and clear of any encumbrances.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Funeral_Arrangements
content_blocks.text: I request that my funeral be held in accordance with the wishes expressed in my prior directive, and that my ashes be interred at Maplewood Memorial Gardens.
